working_definition: Author cell type 'perineurial glial sheath' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head and body, 690 cells): perineurial glia. Authors' term FBbt:00007089 is the sheath (layer structure).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any glial cell that is part of some adult nervous system and is part of some perineurial glial sheath.

justification: Cell-level, adult equivalent of the authors' sheath term: the glial cells that are part of the perineurial glial sheath in the adult. More specific children (brain, optic lobe, VNC, PNS) are not used because of the no-narrowing-by-tissue rule.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: The outermost cellular layer of the nervous system.

recommendation: Map to adult perineurial glial cell.
